_comment: EXAMPLE PROFILE. Runtime source for engine/gitops-rewrite.mjs. Schema: docs/gitops-substitutions-schema.md
_exclude_comment: Empty by design: every component is regenerated, and a new one is picked up automatically. The mechanism stays for a genuine future exclusion, and a stale pinned entry is surfaced as a warning rather than swallowed.
_auto_comment: Applied longest-first so a token that is a prefix of another cannot partially shadow it.
_post_apply_comment: kind:'token' replaces every occurrence of match; kind:'line-value' replaces the scalar value of a `<key>: <value>` line.

post_apply.what: the DR workload identity client id
post_apply.why: DR identities are new, with new client ids that do not exist until the identity root applies

decide.what: on-prem source ranges trusted by the internal gateway
decide.why: on-prem reaches DR over the same links, so keeping the source list is usually right — but confirm it

_forbidden_residual_comment: The completeness guard. Cutover hostnames are deliberately absent: they legitimately survive into the DR overlay.

forbidden_residual.why: source resource name prefix survived the rewrite
source region token survived the rewrite
